newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee holds modest gains, fund sales ebb.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee holds modest gains, fund sales ebb.

text.p: LIFFE coffee futures held modest gains into Thursday midsession after a higher start on follow-through buying as fund and spec selling has ebbed.

The short-covering buying, which appeared on Wednesday afternoon and continued through this morning, helped the market to recoup some $100 it lost in the wake of the fund shake-out on Tuesday and early Wednesday.

But dealings were extremely slow this morning with just 684 lots changing hands. Players have turned cautious pending New York direction and over a frost scare in Brazil rumoured in the market for this weekend.
But private U.S. forecaster Weather Services Corp said in its latest report on Thursday no damaging cold is in sight for the next five days in the coffee areas.
The forecast is for mostly dry weather with lows of 50-66 F Thursday and Friday. Saturday to Monday will be generally dry and mild.
The last crop-damaging frosts in Brazil was in late June and early July 1994.
Benchmark September finished midsession $10 higher at $1,630 a tonne after ranging between $1,620 and $1,1635. The contract saw a five-month low of $1,530 on Wednesday.
